paragraphs.text:
It is later, on a riverbank. You are face down. You don’t know 
how much time has passed. You stir and then moan with pain. 
Everything hurts. Can you find the strength to continue?

Make a CON roll: if you succeed, go to 67; if you fail, the Nadelmann 
Expedition is over. THE END.
